question: What is the ruling on: clearance is mandatory?
why_it_blocks: answered before the question door existed; migrated into the corpus so the system reads its Q&A in one place
answer:
Mandatory — emit refuses uncleared
(the question put to him, carried for context: 'every-crossing-goes-around-the-clearance-gate: is clearance MANDATORY or ADVISORY? Re-measured today — 186 emit-shaped records across the component histories, ZERO carry cleared_by (was 146/0 on 2026-08-05; I added 4 more this session). Still no production caller of clear() anywhere. harbor_master's charter names this exact condition as its own falsifier, so either the falsifier is wrong or emit must refuse an uncleared crossing.')
(the option he selected carried its own scope, and it is part of the ruling: 'Law 4: the chokepoint refuses a crossing carrying no cleared_by. This is a stone, not an edit — it needs an answer for what actor/boat_owner/method a CC-made crossing has, and MethodRegistry has no production register() call, so every crossing would re-run a proof. Also needs a NAMED bootstrap exemption (the gate must be crossed into existence). I'd cast it as a ticket, not build it now.')
